annotations.title: Start date and ways to follow along

description: Call this when the user asks when the 90 days start, how long until Day 1, or whether there is an app. Returns the official 2027 start date with the official page it comes from, Day 90 and Easter Sunday by our count, days until Day 1 in US Eastern time, and the ways to follow Desert Road Catholic: the web and the free iPhone app are live today, the iPhone app with its App Store link; Android is coming soon and has no link yet. Also gives the Desert Road Catholic YouTube channel and the website signup link. Example: "How many days until Exodus 90 starts, and is there an app?"
name: get_follow_options

by_our_count.description: Dates counted by Desert Road Catholic, not stated by the official page.

day.description: Which of the 90 days Easter falls on.

current_day.description: Today's day number, only while the 90 days are in progress.

days_until_day_1.description: Days from today until Day 1 (0 once the road has begun).

official_start.description: The official 2027 start date and the official page it comes from.

source_name.description: Name of the official source page.

source_url.description: URL of the official source page.

signup.description: Where to register. Sign-up happens on the website.

status.description: Where today falls against the 90 days.

timezone.description: Time zone used for today: America/New_York.

ways_to_follow.description: Where to follow along. The iPhone app links to the App Store. Android has no link yet.

details_url.description: Page about the ways to follow along.

url.description: Where to open it: the website for web; App Store URL for iPhone; null for Android while it is coming soon.

youtube_url.description: The Desert Road Catholic YouTube channel.
